insights: **Weekly Highlights —** RationAle grew Total Sales to $4,672, up 15.0% WoW from $4,063, on 292 units. Organic sales led the way at $3,106 (+27.6% WoW), and the Mexican Cerveza 6-Pack was the standout SKU at $1,012 (+174.9%), with units up 180.6% to 87 and conversion rising to 36.9%. The Hazy IPA ($556, +27.3%) and Kolsch ($388, +27.5%) also grew, and Sunday, Nov 8 was the peak day at $750.

**Metrics to Watch —** The Variety Pack eased to $1,916 (-4.9%) on slightly fewer sessions (313, -1.6%) and a softer 22.4% conversion rate (-3.9%), while the West Coast IPA dipped to $439 (-18.5%) as conversion fell to 31.0% (-21.7%) even though sessions rose 4.5% to 116. PPC revenue also eased to $1,565 (-3.9%) even as ad spend rose to $1,310 from $1,136. The silver lining: organic sales climbed 27.6% to $3,106 and carried total sales up 15.0%. We are focused on restoring conversion on the West Coast IPA and Variety Pack to bring both back to growth.

**Ad Spend Efficiency —** TACoS held nearly flat at 28.1% (prior 27.98%) because total sales grew alongside ad spend, and ad conversion stayed solid at 17.04% on a 0.38% ad CTR. ROAS slipped to 1.19x from 1.43x, with $1,310 of spend returning $1,565 in PPC revenue at an 83.7% ACOS. We are correcting this by trimming bids on high-ACOS search terms and moving that budget toward the best-converting SKUs, aiming to hold TACoS near 28% while lifting ROAS back toward 1.43x.

**Actions This Week —** (1) Shift more ad budget to the Mexican Cerveza 6-Pack, which converted at 36.9%, to build on its +174.9% gain. (2) Audit search terms and lower bids on high-ACOS terms to bring ACOS down from 83.7% and ROAS back toward 1.43x. (3) Review West Coast IPA ad targeting and coupon setup to recover its 31.0% conversion rate, and test new Sponsored Brand ad creative to lift ad CTR above 0.38% heading into the holiday season.
